name: Floynk for WooCommerce
author: floynk

sections.description:
Floynk for WooCommerce is the official WordPress plugin for the Floynk service (https://www.floynk.com). Floynk is a hosted repricing platform that helps Dutch and Belgian WooCommerce merchants compete on the Bol.com marketplace without juggling spreadsheets or a second dashboard.

This plugin is a thin connector. The repricing engine, competitor price monitoring, and Bol.com API integration all run on Floynk’s servers. The plugin gives you a settings screen for your Floynk API key, a Bol.com account wizard, and a per-product repricer control inside wp-admin.

You need a Floynk account to use this plugin. Sign up at https://www.floynk.com/wordpress-plugin. The plugin itself is fully functional; Floynk’s hosted service performs the repricing, competitor monitoring, and Bol.com API work on Floynk servers.

What this plugin does

  • Connects your WooCommerce store to your Floynk account with a single API key
  • Bol.com account wizard: add, verify, list, and remove Bol.com seller accounts without leaving wp-admin
  • Per-product repricer controls on the WooCommerce product edit page (min price, max price, activate/hunt/restore)
  • Optional custom product fields for purchase price, shipping cost, EAN, and brand — enable them from the settings screen if you don’t already have another plugin providing them
  • Repricer configuration tab for global hunt behavior, hunt timing, price rounding, and default min/max formulas
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility
  • WordPress multisite support

What this plugin does NOT do

  • Repricing logic. The actual repricer runs on Floynk’s servers. The plugin sends product data and displays results.
  • Direct Bol.com API calls. Your Bol.com credentials are stored on Floynk and used server-side. The plugin never calls Bol.com directly.
  • Payment processing. WooCommerce handles checkout as usual.
  • Store functionality without a Floynk account. You need an account at https://www.floynk.com for the plugin to do anything useful.

External services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services. By using this plugin you agree to the terms and privacy policies of these services.

Floynk API (https://app.floynk.com)

  • What it is: Floynk is a hosted e-commerce platform operated by Floynk B.V. It handles product synchronization, order aggregation, and Bol.com repricing on your behalf.
  • When data is sent: Every time the plugin runs a sync, validates your API key, fetches settings, updates min/max prices, or connects to Bol.com. These calls happen when you explicitly click a button in the plugin settings, when a scheduled sync runs, or when a WooCommerce hook fires (new order, product updated, stock change).
  • What data is sent:
    • Your Floynk API key (as an Authorization header)
    • WordPress site URL and name (for display in your Floynk dashboard)
    • WooCommerce product data (SKU, EAN, name, price, stock, categories — whatever you have configured in WooCommerce)
    • WooCommerce order data (order ID, line items, fulfillment status, shipping address — for marketplace orders)
    • Plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version, and WooCommerce version (for compatibility and debugging)
  • Terms of Use: https://www.floynk.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.floynk.com/privacy

Bol.com (https://www.bol.com) — indirect, via Floynk

This plugin never calls Bol.com directly. When you connect a Bol.com account through the plugin’s Bol.com wizard, your Bol.com client ID and client secret are sent over HTTPS to the Floynk API and stored securely on Floynk’s servers. The Floynk service then uses those credentials server-side to call the Bol.com Retailer API for offer management, order retrieval, and repricing on your behalf.

  • What data Bol.com sees (via Floynk): Offer data (EAN, price, stock, condition, delivery time), order fulfillment updates (shipping, tracking), and whatever else the Bol.com Retailer API requires for normal marketplace operations.
  • Bol.com API documentation: https://developers.bol.com/
  • Bol.com Terms of Use for Partners: https://partnerplatform.bol.com/

Privacy

This plugin does not set any cookies, does not track visitors, does not load third-party scripts on your front-end, and does not collect anonymous analytics. All network activity is limited to the Floynk API, only on your behalf, only with data you have explicitly asked the plugin to sync.

Source code

The plugin is developed in a monorepo alongside the Floynk backend. The source shipped to WordPress.org is the authoritative distribution.
sections.installation:
1. Install WooCommerce 7.0 or higher if you don’t already have it.
  2. Sign up for a free account at https://www.floynk.com/wordpress-plugin and copy your API key from the Floynk dashboard.
  3. Install the plugin: upload the zip through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Navigate to Floynk in the wp-admin menu.
  6. Paste your Floynk API key into the Settings tab and click Test Connection.
  7. Open the Bol.com tab and follow the wizard to connect your Bol.com seller account (your Bol.com credentials are stored on Floynk, never in your WordPress database).
  8. Open any product with an EAN in WooCommerce — the Floynk Repricer metabox appears in the sidebar with controls to activate repricing, set min/max prices, and trigger a price hunt.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Floynk account?

Yes. This plugin is a connector to the Floynk service. Without a Floynk account the plugin cannot reprice anything. You can sign up for a free account at https://www.floynk.com/wordpress-plugin.

Can I create a Floynk account to start?

Yes. You can create a Floynk account at https://www.floynk.com/wordpress-plugin and use this plugin to connect WooCommerce to the hosted Floynk service. The plugin’s local features are available to every connected user.

Where are my Bol.com credentials stored?

On Floynk’s servers, not in your WordPress database. The plugin never sees your Bol.com client ID or client secret after you enter them in the Bol.com connection wizard — the wizard submits them directly to the Floynk API over HTTPS.

Does the plugin phone home?

The plugin talks to the Floynk API (https://app.floynk.com) on your behalf for repricing, Bol.com account management, and settings. It only contacts Floynk, and only with your explicit consent (you installed it and entered your API key). It does not send anonymous telemetry, open-rate pixels, or tracking beacons. See the External services section below for details.

Can I self-host the Floynk service?

No. Floynk is a hosted SaaS service. If you need on-premise repricing, contact https://www.floynk.com/contact to discuss enterprise options.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your WooCommerce store keeps working as usual. The plugin stops repricing. Your Floynk account and any Bol.com integrations continue to exist on Floynk’s servers — deactivating the plugin does not delete your Floynk data. To delete your Floynk account, log in at https://app.floynk.com/account and use the account deletion flow there.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

The plugin is a connector; Floynk (the service) handles personal data on your behalf as a processor. Review Floynk’s Privacy Policy at https://www.floynk.com/privacy to understand what data is stored and for how long. No plugin can provide 100% compliance on its own — you remain the data controller for your WooCommerce store.

I’m a Floynk developer. How do I point the plugin at a dev backend?

Add define('FLOYNK_ENVIRONMENT', 'development'); and optionally define('FLOYNK_API_URL', 'http://localhost:8000/api'); to your wp-config.php. By default the plugin always talks to the production Floynk API.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Scope: the WordPress.org release is focused on the Bol.com repricer and Bol.com account management.
  • Removed account-level gating from the plugin. Every feature in the plugin is shown to every user unconditionally.
  • Fixed: inline admin JavaScript and CSS blocks are now enqueued via wp_enqueue_script() / wp_enqueue_style() with the script data passed through wp_localize_script() per the WordPress developer guidelines.
  • Fixed: removed explicit translation loading; WordPress.org loads plugin translations automatically on supported WordPress versions.
  • Fixed: updated the Terms and Privacy Policy URLs in readme.txt to point at live pages.
  • Removed: the optional self-hosted update checker code path. The plugin now ships exclusively through WordPress.org.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Connect WooCommerce to Floynk with a single API key.
  • Bol.com connection wizard for configuring marketplace accounts.
  • Per-product repricer settings with min/max prices and hunt/restore controls.
  • Repricer configuration tab with hunt behavior, timing, rounding, and default price formulas.
  • Optional custom product fields (purchase price, shipping cost, EAN, brand).
  • WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility.
  • WordPress multisite support.
